# Eyescream

Type: Food | Internal ID: Eyescream | Source: Cauldron, (level 3) | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Greydwarf eye x3, Freeze gland x1 | Max Health: 21 | Max Stamina: 65 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Eyescream is a Mountain-tier food.

## Recipe

Eyescream is produced in a level 3 Cauldron with:
• 3 Greydwarf eye
• 1 Freeze gland

## Notes

• Eyescream provides the highest stamina gain in the Mountains at 65.
